operating_notes.text: ArisUnitern RE Solutions Pvt. Ltd. appointed as strategic land advisory partner for The Address Maker Group across MMR and Bengaluru.
Arisunitern Re Solutions secured a DAAS service order for Wadhwa Wise City, Panvel with potential GDV of ₹650 Cr.
FY26 gross IPO proceeds were fully utilized towards debt repayment and working capital requirements.
Contract manufacturing revenue grew 95% to ₹4,989 Mn and DaaS rose 109% to ₹980 Mn in FY26.
Contract manufacturing contributed 47% of revenues in FY26.
Board approved appointment of MSKC & Associates LLP as statutory auditor on May 15, 2026, subject to shareholder approval.
Arisinfra holds 73.75% stake in AUSPL prior to the merger.
Post-merger paid-up capital will be ₹17.72 Cr.

timeline.summary: On May 5, 2026, Arisinfra Solutions announced that its subsidiary ArisUnitern RE Solutions was appointed as strategic land advisory partner by The Address Maker Group.
Arisinfra subsidiary secured a ₹650 Cr GDV DAAS service order from Wadhwa Group for a Panvel township project.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹343.36 Cr (+55.3% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹19.84 Cr (against a loss of ₹1.37 Cr a year earlier).
On May 8, 2026, Arisinfra Solutions filed its Monitoring Agency Report for Q4FY26 showing IPO and Pre-IPO proceeds utilization.
On May 8, 2026, Arisinfra Solutions reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹1,067.5 Cr and PAT of ₹60.3 Cr, turning net cash positive.
Bhavik Jayesh Khara, Whole Time Director & CFO, shared the audio recording of the May 11, 2026, earnings call on Arisinfra Solutions’ website.
On May 11, 2026, Arisinfra Solutions held its Q4 and FY26 earnings conference call.
Price Waterhouse Chartered Accountants LLP resigned as statutory auditor on May 14, 2026, citing a fee reduction dispute.
Board approved appointment of MSKC & Associates LLP as statutory auditor to fill casual vacancy caused by Price Waterhouse's resignation, subject to shareholder approval.
Arisinfra Solutions scheduled an NCLT-convened meeting of secured creditors for November 25, 2026, to approve the merger of Arisunitern Re Solutions.
Arisinfra Solutions issued a postal ballot notice seeking shareholder approval for material related party transactions up to ₹500 Cr with JS Infra Core and modifying limits for Buildmex-Infra.
